rationale: Operator wfengq approved 2026-10-06 on Claude Code's proposal, accepting an estimated 10-30% chance that validation fails hard condition 2. F2 (count floor 1280) is expressible by the current FullScaleMethodFloor (count_floor_samples) and cannot fail on short ranges. F1 (ratio 0.0167 = 4/240) was rejected: 2-sample differences occur in about 0.25% of applicable 5 ms calibration pairs, and the extrapolated 0.002 s validation ranges (88-96 samples) turn a 2-sample difference into a ratio of 0.021-0.023; every case that breaks F2 also breaks F1. F3 was not chosen because it needs a model and contract 23.4 revision and adds short-segment risk. Known weakness, to be disclosed: low sensitivity (10% aggravation tier still masked in 663/1728 pairs). The 1280 maximum comes from a sampling-phase coincidence (M3 level 1.0, depth 0.9, phase 0, 880 Hz at 48 kHz; the 0.99 crossing at 63 degrees lies on the 0.6-degree sampling grid); held-out parameters with similar coincidences, especially at 3000 Hz, may exceed it. No validation-side data was examined.

stage1.rationale: Operator wfengq approved 2026-10-06 on Claude Code's proposal. K2 is expressible by the current FullScaleMethodFloor fields (K4 would need a model and contract 23.4 revision); K1 is dominated by K2; K3c2 equals K2 and larger c only lowers judgeability and onset detection. Widest domain (n_min 5.5125, p_min 1): domain share 0.96, judgeable share 0.67, no undetected onset pairs, not K0, zero flips outside the k=1 and k=2 fixed minimum. zone_above 0.002004 equals the sampling bound (0.99+2*step)/cos(pi/N)-0.99 at N=50.11; shrinking it to 0.00054 needs n_min 54.55 and drops the domain share to 0.38. Chosen on stage-1 outputs only; no stage-2 output for any alternative row and no validation-side data was examined.
